objective: Review the newest commit on release/0.3.0/feat/installed-scope-default, which rebuilds the setup of two alias tests in packages/runtime/tests/setup-scope.test.ts so they still prove their case on windows-latest.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-scope; review git diff HEAD~1 HEAD (also in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad/scope-win-fix.diff).

On Windows CI, "a tracked local file of another letter case never infers local" found local because git add of a case variant on NTFS added nothing, and "a tracked top-level entry that is the .claude folder by identity never infers local" failed because writing .claude. lands in .claude. The fix adds index entries with git hash-object and update-index --cacheinfo and asserts the index holds them.

Check: each test still asserts user scope and would fail if the product check regressed; the new index assertions prevent a vacuous pass; nothing in the setup is invalid on Windows (path separators, NTFS name rules, core.protectNTFS on update-index).
constraints: Read-only; you may run bun test on that file in that worktree.
